description: This file defines and exports a Xiaomi provider plugin entry for an openclaw extension framework. It imports necessary functions and constants from SDK and other modules, then creates a plugin object with configuration details, provider info, authentication options, and async functions for usage and snapshot fetching.

methods.name: applyXiaomiConfig
methods.description: Applies Xiaomi specific configuration using provided configuration object.

methods.name: buildXiaomiProvider
methods.description: Builds the Xiaomi provider for use in the catalog.
